crossRefs.note: Our help is in Yahweh’s name, who made heaven and earth.
Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:
who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob…
send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,
Yahweh will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
Blessed be Yahweh from Zion, who dwells at Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: May Yahweh bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.
translations.bsb: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
translations.kjv: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
translations.asv: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion; Even he that made heaven and earth.
